C_opencellid.verdict: rejected — worse overall (1/5 folds), though district bias improved (Tawau -69.3→-61.6, Pitas +32.0→+24.5)
C_opencellid.why: OpenCelliD is crowdsourced; Tawau city (40k people, 205 Mbps measured) shows nearest recorded cell 115 km away because contributors never collected there. 62% of settlements have no record within 10 km.
C_opencellid.source: OpenCelliD CC BY-SA 4.0, 1,217 Sabah cell records, updated 2025-02 to 2026-08
